updates.content:
Title: Some users may be intermittently unable to send email messages to Outlook.com, Hotmail.com, or Live.com email addresses


User impact: Users may be intermittently unable to send email messages to Outlook.com, Hotmail.com, or Live.com email addresses.


More info: Users may receive a Non-Delivery Report (NDR) reporting 550 5.7.1 or 550 5.7.23 due to Service Provider Foundation (SPF) violation.

Current status: We've received reports indicating that some users may be unable to send email messages to Outlook.com, Hotmail.com or Live.com email addresses. We're requesting that affected users reach out to their support representatives and provide fresh Network Message IDs, fresh logs, and examples of impact users are facing in .eml format. These logs will aid in the root cause investigation into why impact persists, so we can identify a remediation plan.

Scope of impact: Some users may be intermittently unable to send email messages to Outlook, Hotmail, and Live email accounts. 


Next update by: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 7:00 AM UTC
